justification: DET and Kincaid are locked from the early window — leave them. Caleb starts; I will not apologize for Caleb Williams, and Burden rides with him — that CHI stack is the talent bet and the owner already sees the breakout. AJ Brown is IR dead weight this week, so he sits. Harrison and Judkins are on bad offenses; I am not dying on that hill against Leon Black's Chase/Henry/Burrow core. Downs gets WR1 for usable targets now; Croskey-Merritt takes the FLEX — higher juice than Judkins and the boom I hunt. Jeanty and Skattebo stay. Reichard is the only K. We win this week; Jefferson package talk is for after kickoff.
